item.title: EnHomee 9-Drawer Fabric Dressers Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violates Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units; Sold on Walmart.com by Raybee-Direct
item.company: Xuzhou Mingquanhe Household Co., Ltd., of China
item.brand: Xuzhou Mingquanhe Household Co., Ltd., of China
item.summary: This recall involves EnHomee 9-Drawer Fabric Dressers. The recalled dressers come in white, brown, gray, and black. The dressers have nine fabric drawers, and the frames are made of metal. They are 15.3 inches wide, 27.5 inches tall, 47.2 inches long, and weigh 41.3 pounds. Only orders placed before March 30th 2026, are part of this recall.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: EnHomee 9-Drawer Fabric Dressers.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled dressers immediately if they are not anchored to the wall and place them in an area that children cannot access. Contact Raybee-Direct for instructions on how to identify affected units and dispose of the dressers to receive a full refund. Consumers will be asked to submit a photo to RaybeeRecall@outlook.com demonstrating disposal of the product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
